FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Bullish Trend Persists Above MA20 Amid Resilient US Spending and AI Boom
tldr_points: USD/JPY remains firmly above its 20-day moving average at 156.50, maintaining a strong bullish trajectory.
Resilient US consumer spending and massive AI capital expenditure support the US Dollar against the Yen.
RSI at 61.5 indicates room for further upside before reaching overbought conditions.

FX.comment: Bullish trend remains intact above the 20-day MA, supported by resilient US spending and AI-driven dollar demand.
